events.title: Auguste Rodin Is Born in Paris
events.description: The French sculptor who would create The Thinker and The Burghers of Calais was born in Paris on this day. His raw, expressive style broke with polished academic tradition.
events.significance: Rodin is widely regarded as the father of modern sculpture. He changed how artists portrayed the human body and emotion.

events.title: Sun Yat-sen Is Born
events.description: Sun Yat-sen was born in Cuiheng village in Guangdong, China. He trained as a physician before turning to revolutionary politics.
events.significance: He became a central figure in the movement that overthrew imperial rule in China. He served as the first president of the Republic of China.

events.title: The Tirpitz Is Sunk
events.description: In Operation Catechism, Royal Air Force bombers sank the German battleship Tirpitz near Tromsø, Norway. About 1,000 sailors on board were killed.
events.significance: The sinking removed the largest German warship from the war. It ended a long threat to Allied Atlantic convoys.

events.title: The Bhola Cyclone Strikes East Pakistan
events.description: The deadliest tropical cyclone in recorded history made landfall on the coast of East Pakistan, now Bangladesh. It killed at least 250,000 people.
events.significance: The slow and inadequate government response fueled political anger in East Pakistan. That anger contributed to the movement that led to Bangladesh's independence in 1971.

events.title: Mid-Air Collision Near New Delhi
events.description: A Saudi Arabian Airlines Boeing 747 and a Kazakhstan Airlines Ilyushin Il-76 collided in mid-air near New Delhi. All 349 people aboard both aircraft were killed.
events.significance: It remains the deadliest mid-air collision in aviation history. It led to changes in air traffic procedures, including the wider adoption of collision-avoidance systems.
